1	package markdown
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"strings"
6	
7		"github.com/yuin/goldmark"
8		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
9		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension"
10		east "github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension/ast"
11		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/parser"
12		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/text"
13	
14		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
15		"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/extensions"
16		"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/renderer"
17		storepb "github.com/usememos/memos/proto/gen/store"
18	)
19	
20	// ExtractedData contains all metadata extracted from markdown in a single pass.
21	type ExtractedData struct {
22		Tags     []string
23		Mentions []string
24		Property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property
25	}
26	
27	// Service handles markdown metadata extraction.
28	// It uses goldmark to parse markdown and extract tags, properties, and snippets.
29	// HTML rendering is primarily done on frontend using markdown-it, but backend provides
30	// RenderHTML for RSS feeds and other server-side rendering needs.
31	type Service interface {
32		// ExtractAll extracts tags, properties, and references in a single parse (most efficient)
33		ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
34	
35		// ExtractTags returns all #tags found in content
36		ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
37	
38		// ExtractProperties computes boolean properties
39		ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
40	
41		// RenderMarkdown renders goldmark AST back to markdown text
42		RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)
43	
44		// RenderHTML renders markdown content to HTML
45		RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)
46	
47		// GenerateSnippet creates plain text summary
48		GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
49	
50		// ValidateContent checks for syntax errors
51		ValidateContent(content []byte) error
52	
53		// RenameTag renames all occurrences of oldTag to newTag in content
54		RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
55	}
56	
57	// service implements the Service interface.
58	type service struct {
59		md goldmark.Markdown
60	}
61	
62	// Option configures the markdown service.
63	type Option func(*config)
64	
65	type config struct {
66		enableTags     bool
67		enableMentions bool
68	}
69	
70	// WithTagExtension enables #tag parsing.
71	func WithTagExtension() Option {
72		return func(c *config) {
73			c.enableTags = true
74		}
75	}
76	
77	// WithMentionExtension enables @mention parsing.
78	func WithMentionExtension() Option {
79		return func(c *config) {
80			c.enableMentions = true
81		}
82	}
83	
84	// NewService creates a new markdown service with the given options.
85	func NewService(opts ...Option) Service {
86		cfg := &config{}
87		for _, opt := range opts {
88			opt(cfg)
89		}
90	
91		exts := []goldmark.Extender{
92			extension.GFM, // GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, strikethrough, task lists, autolinks)
93		}
94	
95		// Add custom extensions based on config
96		if cfg.enableTags {
97			exts = append(exts, extensions.TagExtension)
98		}
99		if cfg.enableMentions {
100			exts = append(exts, extensions.MentionExtension)
101		}
102	
103		md := goldmark.New(
104			goldmark.WithExtensions(exts...),
105			goldmark.WithParserOptions(
106				parser.WithAutoHeadingID(), // Generate heading IDs
107			),
108		)
109	
110		return &service{
111			md: md,
112		}
113	}
114	
115	// parse is an internal helper to parse content into AST.
116	func (s *service) parse(content []byte) (gast.Node, error) {
117		reader := text.NewReader(content)
118		doc := s.md.Parser().Parse(reader)
119		return doc, nil
120	}

content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go:355` — `(*service).ExtractAll(content []byte)`, invoked via the wrapper `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`. `ExtractAll` does a single goldmark AST walk over the memo's markdown content and populates a `storepb.MemoPayload_Property` struct (defined in `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85`) plus a tag list; `RebuildMemoPayload` writes the results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- Memo creation — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, called inside `CreateMemo` before the memo is persisted.
- Memo update, but only when the `content` field is part of the update mask — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-451`, inside `UpdateMemo`'s per-field loop (`if path == "content"`).
- A batch job, `Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`, rebuilds the payload for every memo in the store in paginated batches (100 at a time) and calls `Store.UpdateMemo` to persist it. Note: unlike the analogous `s3presign` runner, this `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` is not currently wired into `server/server.go`'s startup — no active caller was found outside its own package, so in the running server it's effectively dormant/available-but-unused; recomputation in production only happens on create/content-update.

**Extracted properties** (from the single AST walk in `ExtractAll`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:355-416`):
- `Tags []string` — all `#tag` nodes, deduplicated case-preserving.
- `Mentions []string` — `@mention` nodes (used separately for mention relations, e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, not stored on `Property`).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block-level child if it's an H1 heading.
- `Property.HasLink` — true if any Markdown link node is present.
- `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block, fenced code block, or inline code span is present.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — true if any GFM task checkbox is present.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked.

These `Tags`/`Property` fields are consumed by the frontend for list/filter UI, e.g. `web/src/components/MemoFilters.tsx:45-53` (`property.hasLink`, `property.hasTaskList`, `property.hasCode`) and `web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts`.
